92 complete rounds, 2025-06-23 to 2026-08-30. 10 of them from 2026-07-31 onward, when full stat capture began.

## What actually drives the score

Least-squares fit of score against each stat, over every complete round:

| Stat                 | R^2  | Strokes per unit | n  |
|----------------------|------|------------------|----|
| Doubles or worse     | 0.76 | +2.09            | 92 |
| Greens in regulation | 0.53 | -1.66            | 90 |
| Penalties *          | 0.36 | +2.04            | 10 |
| Three-putts *        | 0.35 | +1.22            | 9  |
| Up-and-down % *      | 0.28 | -0.10            | 10 |
| Putts                | 0.05 | +0.36            | 92 |
| Fairways             | 0.01 | -0.28            | 91 |

\* Fewer than 15 rounds. Penalties, three-putts and up-and-down were only logged from 2026-07-31, so their R^2 is suggestive, not established.

**score = 80.3 + +2.09 x doubles_or_worse  (R^2=0.76, n=92)**

Doubles explain 76% of the variance in his scoring; greens in regulation explain less, and putts and fairways explain almost nothing. Each disaster hole costs about 2.1 strokes. A round with zero of them projects to 80.
